answer: A glacier of per-task receipts records who did what, and the haven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
